metric: rho_l = RMSE(a_5-a_FP) / RMS(a_FP) at each named stage
primary: ResNet-18 C100 / C10 on the same stage names
read_if_head: difference concentrates at fc: output width. Class-count claim stands; images-per-class confound falls (that would spread through the body).
read_if_depth: difference is already in the body: checkpoint, not C. Paper narrows to these two weights.
read_if_mid: profile in between; report it; do not pick HEAD/DEPTH.
read_if_hygiene_fail: FP/clip5 drifted vs G1/F1/E; do not read HEAD/DEPTH.
